Question: Which model performs the best in terms of Entity F1 score when the percentage of unseen entities in the response is low?
Evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 5, page 8) (image attached): Figure 5: CamRest: Entity F1 comparison on KA sets
[E2] (figure, Figure 5, page 8): a zoomed view of Figure 5 (image attached) [image]

claims.text: Figure 5 shows the Entity F1 comparison on KA sets with the legend showing BoSsNet, Mem2Seq, Seq2Seq+Copy, and Seq2Seq.

cites.quote: Figure 5: CamRest: Entity F1 comparison on KA sets

claims.text: When looking at the lower percentages of unseen entities in the response, the BoSsNet model line stays consistently at the highest position on the Entity F1 Score axis compared to Mem2Seq, Seq2Seq+Copy, and Seq2Seq.

cites.observation: In the plot, the solid black line representing BoSsNet is positioned above all other model lines across the x-axis representing Unseen Entity Percentage in Response.
